scene: A peg-legged tinkerer showcases curious gadgetry upon his cluttered stall counter.
picture: Side-view pixel art along the steel deck. Far left stands a stack of brass pipes. Left rests a wooden counter with a closed clockwork music box. Centre stands the player in his burnt-orange jacket, beside an eccentric tinkerer. The tinkerer holds an open glowing copper compass on the right. Far right hangs a swaying rope ladder.
shown: an ornate clockwork music box sitting closed on the left table edge
a glowing copper compass lying open in the stallkeeper's palm on the right
a dangling hemp rope ladder swaying on the far right
